title: Genie Code for AI Runtime (Public Preview)
body: Use Genie Code to develop and troubleshoot deep learning workloads in notebooks connected to AI Runtime. Now in [Public Preview](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types), it generates distributed training code, resolves environment and dependency issues, and debugs GPU and distributed workload failures. See [Use Genie Code with AI Runtime](/aws/en/machine-learning/ai-runtime/genie-code).
